interface.longDescription: A two-skill engineering plugin with one accountable delivery path. Veteran Full-Stack Engineer owns repository-wide engineering. defaultPrompt: Take ownership of this software task end to end, using the frontend design specialist whenever visual UI quality or design-system work is material.
Audit this product across engineering and UI quality, implement the highest-value fixes, and verify the real runtime result.
Build this feature as a production-quality vertical slice, including polished frontend behavior and rendered QA when applicable.
